root_observations: Bienert-Klopsch arXiv:0810.3440 (read body, lines 20-32): the permutation-group realization question for binary codes is 'more subtle'; Knapp-Schmid [7] only 'indicated a possible approach'.

Rodrigues 2002 PhD thesis (UKZN open repository, read via reviewer receipt sha 94e35162...): Knapp-Schmid considered [n,k,d]_q codes whose monomial automorphism group is A_n, S_n or a Mathieu group in its degree-n representation.
zbMATH review of Phelps 1985 (Zbl 0632.94010): abstract-group realization via graphs; no free-action statement.
Authors' follow-up arXiv:2402.10667v1 (16 Feb 2024) already cites the journal DOI 10.1142/S0219498825501373 (so accepted by then) and reports no counterexample or resolution for the involution case.
These make subsumption unlikely but do not give the exact Knapp-Schmid theorem statement.
decision: HOLD: targeted bounded prior-art lane quasicode-priorart-r1 to obtain Knapp-Schmid's exact theorem statements (zbMATH cited-by and open citing bodies) and screen explicit free-C2 constructions; then root ruling on D/E, manuscript and root replay.
